scope: Offscreen renderer-reported pass timing diagnostic: sum of average redraw-pass times for a fixed 2s frame, three rotated rounds, same DLL with direct filtering off/on. GPU profiling is enabled here and disabled in normal Aperture. This does not establish visible playback throughput, app CPU/RAM or shader-arithmetic cost. No VLC run.
limits: The baseline first separable pass dominates the reported ~4ms. These timer-bracketed backend calls can include submission/query effects; the cause of that large interval is not established.
The diagnostic cannot be translated into a percentage app performance improvement.
Whole-player performance after adopting this build remains unmeasured because visible tests are deferred.
